h1: Legacy system links, no rebuild needed
overview: We connect older systems to modern tools without replacing them. Your old software might only offer a database, a file export or an outdated interface. We build a small bridge that reads from it, translates the data into a clean modern format and passes it on to your store, app or CRM. The old system stays untouched, and we document how the bridge works.

faq: What kind of old systems can you connect?
Desktop software with a database, on-premise servers, SOAP or XML services, and tools that only export CSV or FTP files. We check what access exists before you pay.
Will you change my old system?
No, not unless you ask. The bridge sits beside it and reads what it already provides. Any write-back is agreed in writing first and tested on a copy.
Do you need to log into my server?
We work through access you grant, such as a read-only database user or a shared folder. We never ask for passwords in chat, and you can remove our access any time.
What if the old system has no export at all?
Then we look at options such as reading the database directly or scheduled reports. If nothing safe works, we tell you before starting and no work is done.
